name: tree-sitter-pawn
description: Tree-sitter grammar for Pawn v3 used by SA-MP/open.mp.

scripts.diagnose:parser: du -h src/parser.c && wc -l src/parser.c && grep -E '^#define (STATE_COUNT|SYMBOL_COUNT|ALIAS_COUNT|TOKEN_COUNT)' src/parser.c
scripts.check:external: npm run test:external:fetch && npm run test:external
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run generate && npm run diagnose:parser && npm run check:parser-size && npm run test:alignment && npm test && npm run test:queries && npm run test:formatter && npm run test:scanner
